name: Aanya Foujaa
original_name: アーニャ・フォージャー
source:
A girl given the role of the daughter within the Forger family.
She is a psychic with telekinetic powers that allows her to read other people's thoughts, but she keeps this a secret from those around her.

[From [url=https://promo.shonenjump.com/spyfamily/14cp/doorway/]official site[/url]]
